dialogue.intro: Grab some wood and make a crafting table. Food and a few tools are probably a good idea after that.
dialogue.progress: Make a crafting table from wooden planks.
dialogue.complete: Crafting table sorted. Time for some tools.

dialogue.intro: You'll need a stone pickaxe before you can mine iron. Might as well make one now.
dialogue.progress: Craft a stone pickaxe with cobblestone and sticks.
dialogue.complete: That should last a bit longer than the wooden one.

dialogue.intro: Get an obsidian portal built, then light it. Bring food, spare blocks and a flint and steel.
dialogue.complete: Worth writing down where the portal is before you wander off.

dialogue.intro: A small farm saves you having to hunt for food every time you head out. Plant a few seeds near water.
dialogue.progress: Till some soil near water and plant a seed.
dialogue.complete: Let that grow while you're doing something else. Plant more when you've got spare seeds.

dialogue.intro: Wooden tools don't last long. Mine some stone and grab the cobblestone for a stone pickaxe.
dialogue.complete: Keep some cobblestone for a furnace too. There's a bit of food here if you need it.
dialogue.progress: Mine stone with a pickaxe and collect the cobblestone.

dialogue.intro: Put some raw iron in a furnace and let it smelt. An iron pickaxe and a bucket are both useful early on.
dialogue.complete: There we go. Save up a few more ingots for a pickaxe or a bucket.
dialogue.progress: Smelt raw iron in a furnace and take the ingot out.
